thread:
mina_devops: Heads-up: planning to switch archive buckets + backup snapshots to CMKs (customer-managed). Will also tighten RBAC and require ephemeral grants for uploader/rehydrator. Any immediate blockers?

ari_security: Need to ensure CloudTrail captures CreateGrant/RetireGrant and Decrypt events for the new key. Also no principal should have kms:* on account.

tom_infra: On uploader side we can create grant at job start and retire after finish. But lifecycle rehydration jobs run as a different service; they must adopt grant flow too.

zara_backup: If rehydrators run in batch windows, they may outlive grant TTL. Suggest grant TTL 15m and rehydration orchestrator refreshes grant.

mina_devops: Good point. We'll add a manifest file next to each backup object with {sha256,key-id,timestamp} so audit can correlate.

ari_security: Also add an IAM condition: deny decrypt unless request contains tag:backup-manifest=true (set by uploader). That prevents rogue decrypts.

oncall-bot: Ticket ENC-9999 opened: "CMK flip + ephemeral grant adoption + manifest audit" assigned to @mina_devops and @ari_security. ETA 6h.

tom_infra: Quick snippet I'm planning to use in uploader (pseudocode):
```
grant = kms.create_grant(keyId, grantee=uploader-sa, operations=[Encrypt,Decrypt], ttl=900)
uploader.upload(obj)
bucket.put(obj.key + ".manifest", {sha, keyId: grant.keyId})
kms.retire_grant(grantId)
```

zara_backup: Can we also schedule a canary restore that runs a decrypt + content-verify against manifests every night? If mismatch -> page.

ari_security: Yes. And add CloudWatch alarm on CloudTrail filter for kms:RetireGrant failures and any Decrypt:AccessDenied for the key.

mina_devops: I'll run a staging test: create grant, upload, manifest, restore. Will post results here.

zara_backup: One gotcha: DB snapshot operator creates snapshots on behalf of service role. Ensure that role has transition grants during the cutover window or snapshots fail.

tom_infra: Will prepare a 20m dual-grant window where both old and new CMKs have grants so in-flight snapshots succeed.

mina_devops: Staging run complete: decrypt ok, manifest SHA matches. No unexpected principals with decrypt perms.

ari_security: Great. After prod flip, run RBAC diff and keep the CloudTrail bucket retention 90d. Postmortem doc required if any failed decrypts in 7d.

zara_backup: I'll follow up with PRs for rehydrator and orchestrator.

mina_devops: Thanks all. Proceeding with cutover in maintenance window tonight. :rocket:
